scope: Inspection, planning, implementation, validation, reporting and original final response; exclude follow-up turns.

projection.assumptions: Full feature implementation, regression checks, several validation passes; estimate only.

accounting_notes: Cumulative ending total_token_usage minus cumulative pre-task total_token_usage; snapshots are not summed.
Cached input is included in input; reasoning output is included in output.
Starting counters are the last token_count before the original task_started event. Prior chat turn excluded.
Follow-up task_started is a strict upper boundary; follow-up turn usage is excluded.

auxiliary_usage.note: No implementation subagents used. Tool-side automatic approval-review usage, if incurred, is outside the available primary cumulative counters and is unmeasured.

completeness_scope: Primary Codex session/model usage for the original implementation turn, including its final response. Follow-up excluded. Auxiliary tool-side model usage is not exposed.
